name: UAL 221 乘客心脏病 乘客不舒服

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 221, you are maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL221, maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, maintain 9200 meters, direct to X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，保持 9200 米，直飞 X-Ray Sierra Hotel。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 9200 meters, direct to XSH, UAL221.

cards.audioText: B: You are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, contact Shanghai Control and check if any higher level is available.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，联系上海管制，询问是否有更高高度可用。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL221, we are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, is higher level available ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL221，我们在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，是否有更高高度可用？

cards.audioText:
C: United 221, 11600 meters is available now, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you are unable to accept 11600 meters because of performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 221，11600 米现在可用，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员因性能原因无法接受 11600 米。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we are unable to accept 11600 meters due performance, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，因性能原因无法接受 11600 米，UAL221。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, maintain present level, expect higher level after X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，保持当前高度，过 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 后预计可上升至更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，过 XSH 后预计可上升至更高高度，UAL221。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over X-Ray Sierra Hotel, maintaining 9200 meters, contact Wuhan Control and request higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 X-Ray Sierra Hotel，保持 9200 米，联系武汉管制请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, over XSH, maintaining 9200 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL221，飞越 XSH，保持 9200 米，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10400 meters, UAL221.

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, contact Wuhan Control and request descent to lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然有 1 名旅客心脏病发作，联系武汉管制，请求下降到较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, request descent to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL221，1 名旅客心脏病发作，请求下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, maintain 10400 meters due airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，因空域拥挤，保持 10400 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10400 meters, reduce speed to M.75, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 10400 米，减速至 M.75，UAL221。

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，向武汉管制报告并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, the flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL221，乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, descend to 6600 meters, level at X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，下降至 6600 米，在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 改平。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，在 XSH 改平，UAL221。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, track direct to X-Ray Sierra Hotel, follows Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，直飞 X-Ray Sierra Hotel，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to XSH, follows ZF2A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36R, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 XSH，执行 ZF2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL221。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information Oscar, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 Zulu Foxtrot，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 Oscar，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL221, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL221，飞越 ZF，保持 6600 米，收到通播 O。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, current information is Papa, descend to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为 Papa，下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Information P, descend to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，UAL221。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL221。

cards.audioText: C: United 221, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 221，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL221。
